This topic cannot demonstrate a real legacy HDFS/YARN estate in this sandbox; only the modern pattern's storage-and-table-format layer is run for real, disclosed in OUTLINE.md and FACT-CHECK.md, with the legacy estate described from the syllabus's own framing rather than demonstrated
The cost-comparison numbers in examples.py are disclosed as an illustrative model built to demonstrate the mechanism, not a claim about any real organization's actual bill
